profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer at Direct Supply
profile.summary:
I am a Software Engineer who graduated from the University of Wisconsin-Madison. Working as a Software Engineer has been a great achievement in my life. I enjoy writing code, maintaining applications and configuring architecture, especially in the cloud as companies continue to migrate. My strengths as an Engineer are built from my quick learning ability and strong analysis skills. From a non-technical view, helping and working with others drives me to succeed, and I enjoy fostering strong, healthy relationships with others.

Email: earndt23@outlook.com

positions.title: Enterprise Support Technologist
positions.description:
• Sustained technology for over 400 Wisconsin School of Business faculty and staff
• Formulated solutions to difficult problems alongside 10 full-time and part-time coworkers
• Consulted with various business school departments to achieve organizational success

positions.title: IT Business Analyst Intern - Vendor Management & Sourcing
positions.description:
• Led summer-long innovation project that culminated with a presentation to executives
• Analyzed current team processes to increase time savings for VMO Operations by 25%
• Collaborated internally and with external vendors to gather requirements for upcoming projects
• Improved project forecasting by 50% by integrating existing applications
• Condensed vendor request intake form by one page to improve convenience and accessibility

positions.title: IT Procurement Applications Intern
positions.description:
• Assisted the Corporate Solutions Team with application support and projects
• Fulfilled over 15 customer-submitted tickets per day to maintain SAP workflow
• Refreshed and deployed computers to end users to stay up to date with current technology
